payload.evidence_against: A PF-only router cannot reach the newly measured T041 seven-candidate oracle, and prior E011/E006 uncertainty routing failed legal identification.
payload.evidence_for: E013's E011/PF/fixed-blend oracle reaches 7.854264 on all 773 wells, gaining 2.129642 versus the fixed blend. T041 adds stable and heavy-tail HMM candidates and lowers the 100-well component oracle to 5.883054.
payload.next_test: Superseded by H034/T042, which retains PF-internal risk as part of a broader posterior-uncertainty and complete-path disagreement selector.
payload.statement: PF-internal test-available diagnostics can identify the minority of catastrophic sequential-PF wells strongly enough to justify a separately validated exact-E011 abstention mechanism.
payload.title: PF internal state identifies catastrophic tracking failures
